title: Custom Undo/Redo Across Embedded Code Regions
summary: Give the prompt editor a single PromptUndoManager that owns Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y across host text and every embedded AvalonEdit region, restoring the exact selection and caret from a {serializedText, caretOffset, anchorOffset} snapshot over the flat GetPlainText()/ToFencedText() serialization. caretOffset and anchorOffset are absolute offsets in that one flat coordinate space, so a single selection may straddle the host↔region boundary and must still capture and restore with correct span and direction. Native RichTextBox undo and per-region AvalonEdit undo are suppressed so exactly one authority exists; edits coalesce and history clears on send.

tasks.title: Decide the single-authority prompt undo architecture
tasks.description:
Establish and record the authoritative design for prompt undo/redo before any wiring begins.

## Observable outcome

A new entry in `.squad/decisions.md` plus a design contract that tasks 002-006 consume, so the implementation has one agreed model rather than per-task reinterpretation. No production behavior changes in this task.

## Decisions to fix

- A single `PromptUndoManager` owns Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y for the entire prompt `RichTextBox`, including when focus is inside an embedded region's AvalonEdit control.
- The undo unit is a snapshot `{serializedText, caretOffset, anchorOffset}` captured over the flat `GetPlainText()`/`ToFencedText()` serialization.
- **Absolute flat coordinate space.** `caretOffset` and `anchorOffset` are absolute offsets measured from the start of the single flat serialized prompt, a coordinate space that spans host text AND every embedded region's fenced span. Because both endpoints live in one space, a single selection may straddle the host↔region boundary in either orientation (anchor in host / caret in region, or anchor in region / caret in host).
- **Selection-direction rule.** `anchorOffset` and `caretOffset` are stored separately so a forward selection (anchor before caret) and a backward selection (caret before anchor) each restore with the active caret on the correct end; the manager's authoritative range is the absolute [min,max] span plus the stored direction.
- Single-authority routing suppresses native `RichTextBox` undo and each region's AvalonEdit per-region undo stack.
- Rapid consecutive edits coalesce into one undo entry; undo/redo history clears when the prompt is sent.

## Consumers

Tasks 002 (snapshot engine), 003 (routing), 004 (coalescing/clear), 005 (tests), and 006 (review fixture) all build on this contract.

outputs.description: Agreed snapshot shape, absolute-flat-coordinate model (including boundary-straddling selections), selection-direction rule, single-authority routing/suppression rules, and coalescing/clear-on-send policy recorded in .squad/decisions.md.

tasks.title: Capture and restore prompt snapshots across the region seam
tasks.description:
Implement `PromptUndoManager` snapshot capture and apply over the flat serialization, grounded in `EmbeddedCodeRegionManager.ResolveCaretPointerAfterRebuild`/`GetCaretOffset`, `RichTextBoxExtensions.GetPlainText` and its fenced-offset mapping (`GetCharOffset`/`GetTextPointerAt`), and the `IRegionCodeEditor`/`AvalonEditRegionEditor` seam (`CaretOffset`, `SelectionStart`, `SelectionLength`).

## Observable outcome

Capturing a snapshot then applying it rebuilds the prompt document from `serializedText` and restores the exact selection — same span, same caret end — for host-text selections, collapsed carets, selections entirely inside one region, and selections that straddle the host↔region boundary. This capture/apply engine is consumed by the Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y routing in task 003 and the coalescing/clear path in task 004.

## Boundary-straddling selections (first-class)

`caretOffset` and `anchorOffset` are absolute offsets in the one flat serialized-prompt coordinate space that spans host text and every embedded region's fenced span. A single selection may straddle the host↔region boundary in either orientation: anchor in host text with caret inside a region, OR anchor inside a region with caret in host text. Capture and restore must resolve a selection whose anchor and caret resolve to DIFFERENT surfaces — one host `TextPointer`, one in-region AvalonEdit offset — into one coherent WPF-level selection spanning the `BlockUIContainer` boundary, preserving direction (which endpoint is the moving caret).

Because `GetCharOffset` treats a region's fenced span as one indivisible block, an absolute offset that lands inside a region must additionally resolve to that specific region plus its internal AvalonEdit local offset. The content base is the absolute offset of the first content character after the opener line: for a fenced span serialized as `{fence}{lang}\n{content}\n{fence}`, content local offset L maps to absolute (spanStart + fenceLen + langLen + 1 + L).

If a WPF `RichTextBox` selection cannot natively render a single visible highlight spanning a `BlockUIContainer` plus its nested AvalonEdit control, the authoritative selection in `PromptUndoManager` remains the absolute [min,max] range with stored direction, and the visible selection must reflect that range as faithfully as the control composition allows. The straddle case must never be silently dropped.

agentAssignments.role: Implement snapshot capture/apply and the cross-seam selection resolution

outputs.description: PromptUndoManager snapshot capture/apply over the flat serialization, resolving host, in-region, and boundary-straddling selections (both orientations) with preserved direction.

contractExamples.title: Forward host-text selection
contractExamples.input:
Flat serialized prompt (host text only): Hello world
anchor=4, caret=9 (anchor before caret).
contractExamples.expectedBehavior: Restore selects absolute [4,9) with the active caret at offset 9 (forward direction).

contractExamples.title: Backward host-text selection
contractExamples.input:
Flat serialized prompt (host text only): Hello world
anchor=9, caret=4 (caret before anchor).
contractExamples.expectedBehavior: Restore selects the same absolute span [4,9) but backward, with the active caret at offset 4.

contractExamples.title: Collapsed caret, no selection
contractExamples.input:
Flat serialized prompt (host text only): Hello world
anchor=6, caret=6.
contractExamples.expectedBehavior: Restore places a collapsed caret at absolute offset 6 with no highlighted selection.

contractExamples.title: Selection entirely inside one region
contractExamples.input:
Flat serialized prompt (host + one region):
Hello
```python
x=1
```
World
Region fenced span = absolute [6,23); region content "x=1" content base = absolute 16. anchor=16 (content local 0), caret=18 (content local 2).
contractExamples.expectedBehavior: Restore selects region content local [0,2) entirely inside that region's AvalonEdit; no host text is selected; active caret at content local offset 2.

contractExamples.title: Host anchor, in-region caret (forward straddle)
contractExamples.input:
Flat serialized prompt (host + one region):
Hello
```python
x=1
```
World
Region fenced span = absolute [6,23); region content "x=1" content base = absolute 16. anchor=2 (host text, inside "Hello"), caret=18 (inside the region, content local offset 2).
contractExamples.expectedBehavior: Restore produces one coherent selection running from the host anchor at absolute 2 into the region, with the active (moving) caret inside the region at content local offset 2. Direction preserved: anchor outside the region, caret inside it.

contractExamples.title: In-region anchor, host caret (inverse straddle)
contractExamples.input:
Flat serialized prompt (host + one region):
Hello
```python
x=1
```
World
Region fenced span = absolute [6,23); region content "x=1" content base = absolute 16. anchor=17 (inside the region, content local offset 1), caret=26 (host text, inside "World" after the region).
contractExamples.expectedBehavior: Restore produces one coherent selection running from the in-region anchor (content local offset 1) out to the host caret at absolute 26, with the active (moving) caret in host text after the region. The inverse straddle orientation is preserved: anchor inside the region, caret outside it.

tasks.title: Route Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y through the single authority
tasks.description:
Wire prompt-level Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y to `PromptUndoManager` push/undo/redo and make it the only undo authority.

## Observable outcome

Pressing Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y in the prompt — whether keyboard focus is in host text or inside a focused region's AvalonEdit — drives the single `PromptUndoManager`, restoring snapshots via the task 002 engine. Native `RichTextBox` undo and each region's AvalonEdit per-region undo stack are suppressed so there is exactly one history.

## Consumers

The production prompt editor consumes this routing; task 005 asserts the mapping headlessly and GATE-001 confirms the live single-authority behavior.

agentAssignments.role: Wire single-authority Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y routing and suppress native/per-region undo

outputs.description: Prompt Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y routed to the single PromptUndoManager with native and per-region undo suppressed.

tasks.title: Coalesce rapid edits and clear history on send
tasks.description:
Add edit coalescing and clear-on-send to `PromptUndoManager`.

## Observable outcome

Rapid consecutive edits collapse into a single undo entry (one Ctrl+Z reverses a burst of typing rather than one character at a time), and the undo/redo history is cleared when the prompt is sent so a fresh prompt starts with an empty history.

## Consumers

The production prompt-send path and the undo manager consume this behavior; GATE-001 confirms the coalesced undo live.

outputs.description: Rapid-edit coalescing into single undo entries and history clear on prompt send.

tasks.title: Prove flat-offset selection round-trips headlessly
tasks.description:
Add deterministic NUnit coverage for the capture→apply round-trip of the flat-offset ↔ caret/anchor/selection mapping.

## Observable outcome

Headless tests capture absolute offsets, apply the snapshot, and assert the restored absolute `anchorOffset`, `caretOffset`, and direction match for: forward host selection, backward host selection, collapsed caret, a selection with both endpoints inside one region, and the two boundary-straddling cases — straddle-forward (host anchor + in-region caret) and straddle-backward (in-region anchor + host caret). The straddle cases capture absolute offsets that cross the host↔region boundary, apply, and assert the restored absolute anchor/caret and direction (which endpoint is the active caret) are preserved.

## Consumers / conventions

Reuse or parameterize the project's established EmbeddedCodeRegion/EmbeddedCaretNav tests rather than adding a parallel harness. Build with env var DOTNET_MSBUILD_SDK_RESOLVER_CLI_DIR only (NU1701 is benign). Run with NUnit filters `FullyQualifiedName~EmbeddedCodeRegion|FullyQualifiedName~EmbeddedCaretNav`. These tests are the regression evidence task 007 reuses.

tasks.title: Prepare the prompt-undo live review simulation
tasks.description:
Build a reproducible review path for the live undo/redo human checks, per the workspace decision that human UI approval checkpoints must have a reproducible review path.

## Observable outcome

A Developer → Simulation entry titled "Prompt Undo Review" loads a prompt containing host text and at least one embedded code region, positioned so a reviewer can reproduce every undo/redo selection scenario — forward and backward host selections, a collapsed caret, a selection entirely inside a region, redo, in-region Ctrl+Z routing, and a selection that STARTS in host text and ENDS inside a region (boundary-straddling). The simulation exercises the real undo action path, not a static visual.

## Approval procedure

Emit the concise setup/open/observe/cleanup approval procedure that SquadDash absorbs into the durable GATE-001 Inbox message, placing each `{{approval-check:<requirementId>}}` marker immediately before its observation for the seven GATE-001 requirements. The simulation output is consumed by GATE-001 as its fixture.

agentAssignments.role: Build the Developer → Simulation review fixture and emit the approval procedure

outputs.description: Developer → Simulation 'Prompt Undo Review' fixture (host text plus an embedded region) that reproduces all undo/redo selection scenarios including a boundary-straddling selection, with the GATE-001 approval procedure.
